title: Meghalaya Honeymoon murder: Supreme Court seeks response of accused wife on State's plea to cancel bail
description: The Supreme Court on Friday sought the response of Indore resident Sonam Raghuvanshi on a plea seeking cancellation of her bail in the case of murder of her husband during their honeymoon in East Khasi Hills [State of Meghalaya v Sonam Raguvanshi].A bench of Justices MM Sundresh and Sheel Nagu issued notice to Raghuvanshi on a plea filed by State of Meghalaya challenging the bail granted to her by the trial court and upheld by the Meghalaya High Court.Solicitor General (SG) Tushar Mehta, ap
